pomo-01-c3.text: Peter Gratton (2018). Jean-François Lyotard. Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy.
pomo-01-c3.quote: I define postmodern as incredulity toward metanarratives.
pomo-01-c3.claim: The second is incredulity toward metanarratives, Lyotard's signature line.

pomo-09-c1.text: Baghramian, Maria, Carter, J. Adam (2015). Relativism. Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy.
pomo-09-c1.quote: Plato’s attempted refutation of Protagoras, known as peritrope or “turning around”, is the first of the many attempts to show that relativism is self-refuting.
pomo-09-c1.claim: The oldest objection to relativism, traceable to Plato's Theaetetus against Protagoras, is that it refutes itself.

pomo-02-c1.quote: I define postmodern as incredulity toward metanarratives.
pomo-02-c1.claim: "I define postmodern as incredulity toward metanarratives" (incrédulité à l'égard des métarécits).

pomo-02-c1.text: Internet Encyclopedia of Philosophy. Lyotard, Jean-François. Internet Encyclopedia of Philosophy.

pomo-03-c1.text: Aylesworth, Gary (2005). Postmodernism. Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy.
pomo-03-c1.quote: Baudrillard argues that all of these realities have become simulations, that is, signs without any referent
pomo-03-c1.claim: Signs circulate without referents; the question "what is this image of?" becomes increasingly difficult to answer.
